data.name: Cancelled
data.value: SYSVOL acquisition cancelled; no abandoned result accepted

data.name: TimedOut
data.value: SYSVOL operation {0} at {1} made no progress for {2} seconds. Its acquisition was abandoned; completed evidence is retained and the remaining operations in this policy were not attempted.

data.name: WorkerFailed
data.value: SYSVOL acquisition could not complete at {0}: {1}

data.name: WorkerUnavailable
data.value: The previous SYSVOL worker could not be confirmed stopped. No replacement worker was started; this acquisition was not performed.

data.name: ProtocolInvalid
data.value: The SYSVOL worker returned an invalid or unrelated message; no acquisition result was accepted.

data.name: NoExecutable
data.value: The running executable could not be located for isolated SYSVOL acquisition.

data.name: LogFailed
data.value: The SYSVOL operation log could not be written; this is a logging failure, not missing directory evidence.
